_description:
Ship modules (equipment_shipupgrade_*) -> server/data/ship_modules.json (roadmap Phase 6).

The type of the 145 modules (DAMAGE, HP, SHIELD, SPECIAL) is from the client's item data (data/client_items.json); the effects and the ships they can be equipped on
are from the client's own description: "5% increased laser damage and 15% increased rocket damage if equipped on your ship. This
ship upgrade module can be used on the following ships: Cyborg, Hecate, Hecate Plus, Tempest." Effect names are converted to the server's bonus
keys (laser, rocket, npc, shield, hp, speed, evasion, hit (laser and rocket), laser_hit_chance, rocket_hit_chance, shield_penetration, ep, pvp).
Unstable modules (X1/X2/X3, XA01, XV03 ... "series unstable module"): the minimum increase in the client's description ("at least a 5%
boost") and the priority ships ("higher chance of affecting the ..."); their values are determined randomly by Restabilize (ship_module.py).
Each unstable module is written with its series' Restabilize values (recycling, re-roll cost and entitlement: wiki assembly-restabilize and the
UnstableModulesListCommand in the real recording) and value ranges (wiki modules-damage/-hitpoints/-shield/-special: two tiers, big and
small chance). For stable modules, if the base ship is in the list, the Plus version is added too (wiki: "Non-unstable modules usable by non-plus
variants can be equipped by plus variants", 16.11.2021).
Ship names are matched with the client's ship names (items_ship_*_fullname) and abbreviations.
Generated by: tools/ship_modules.py.
